item.title: Mississippi Department of Revenue to visit campuses for Career Fair
item.description: MISSISSIPPI (KTVE/KARD) -- The Mississippi Department of Revenue will be visiting campuses to connect with students interested in turning their skills into careers. Courtesy photo Mississippi Department of Revenue Anyone interested in opportunities in accounting, information technology, or customer service, this is the perfect time to do so. item.title: Nike faces federal probe over allegations of 'DEI-related' discrimination against white workers
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The federal agency for protecting workers' civil rights revealed Wednesday that it is investigating sportswear giant Nike for allegedly discriminating against white employees through its diversity policies. The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission disclosed the investigation in a motion filed in Missouri federal court demanding that Nike fully comply with a subpoena [...]

item.title: Over 450,000 Jeep and Ram model vehicles recalled
item.description: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) just announced that Chrysler is recalling several models totaling more than 450,000 vehicles.

item.title: Enchanted Drive on Wisconsin Avenue in Vicksburg to be closed Feb. 5th
item.description: VICKSBURG, Miss. (KTVE/KARD) -- Enchanted Drive on Wisconsin Avenue will be closed for utility construction starting Thursday, Feb. 5, and the closure is expected to last one week. Those attending, should plan to use an alternate route. To hear audio alert visit https://hrpow.us/wGBauap.
